title: L2/ L3 DevOps Production Support Engineer
description:
Provide L2/L3 production support for business-critical applications running on Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure. Monitor platform health, troubleshoot incidents, and support deployments across on-premises, cloud, or hybrid environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Monitor Linux servers, containerized applications, Kubernetes clusters, and cloud infrastructure for availability and resource utilization.
* Investigate outages, performance degradation, connectivity issues, and deployment failures across pods, containers, services, and ingress controllers.
* Support CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Git, and deployment automation tools.
* Support production releases, configuration changes, and rollbacks.
* Troubleshoot cloud compute, storage, and networking issues, and automate recurring operational tasks.

**What You’ll Need**

* Hands-on production support experience with Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Experience troubleshooting Kubernetes workloads, service connectivity, ingress, and cluster resources.
* Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and production deployments using Jenkins, Git, or equivalent tools.
* Experience monitoring infrastructure and diagnosing CPU, memory, disk, network, and application availability issues.
* Working knowledge of cloud compute, storage, and networking, plus scripting or automation skills.

Interested can reach us at saranyadevib@talentien.com
  
  
Skills: infrastructure,kubernetes,docker,production support,linux

title: SCT-Tech Enablement-Digital supply chain lead-FDE-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SCT-Tech Enablement - Manager**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front-end and back-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full-stack web applications using modern front-end and back-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge-sharing across teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 6–10 years of hands-on experience in full-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Platform Support Engineer – Kubernetes, Linux & Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Role Summary**

We are looking for an Application Monitoring / L2 Support Engineer to provide continuous monitoring, incident detection, initial troubleshooting and operational support for enterprise digital applications.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying production issues proactively, responding to alerts, performing initial diagnosis and coordinating with specialized L2/L3 engineers to restore services within agreed SLAs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor application availability, performance, API health and production infrastructure using monitoring dashboards.
* Identify and respond to application alerts, service failures and abnormal system behavior.
* Perform initial investigation of application, API, database connectivity and infrastructure issues.
* Create, categorize, prioritize and manage incidents through the ITSM/ticketing platform.
* Perform standard troubleshooting and execute approved recovery procedures using operational runbooks.
* Participate in rotational shifts and critical production incident escalations.
* Escalate complex issues to Java, Web/Mobile, DevOps, DBA or other specialist teams.
* Monitor batch jobs, scheduled processes, application integrations and background services.
* Track incident response and resolution timelines to support SLA compliance.
* Prepare daily operational health reports, incident summaries and shift handover reports.
* Support major incident bridges, RCA data collection and post-incident reviews.
* Maintain monitoring dashboards, alert configurations, knowledge-base articles and runbooks.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Experience: 2 - 5 years
* Experience in application monitoring, production support or IT operations.
* Hands-on knowledge of monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, Splunk, Zabbix or similar.
* Good understanding of Linux commands and basic troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP status codes and API health checks.
* Basic SQL knowledge for investigating application/data issues.
* Understanding of application logs, server metrics, alerts and performance indicators.
* Experience with incident management and ticketing tools such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management.
* Knowledge of incident prioritization, escalation procedures and SLA management.
* Strong communication, documentation and shift handover skills.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to Java/Spring Boot or React application environments.
* Basic understanding of Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with APM tools and distributed tracing.
* Experience supporting telecom or customer-facing digital platforms.
* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Knowledge of scripting or monitoring automation.

title: Java Springboot Application Support Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Java / Spring Boot Application Support Engineer to provide L2/L3 production support for enterprise digital applications and backend services.

The candidate will be responsible for investigating production incidents, troubleshooting Java-based applications, REST APIs, microservices and integrations, ensuring service availability and supporting timely incident resolution in accordance with defined SLAs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide L2/L3 production support for Java, Spring Boot and microservices-based applications.
* Investigate and resolve application errors, API failures, performance issues and integration-related incidents.
* Analyze application logs, stack traces, exceptions and monitoring alerts to identify root causes.
* Troubleshoot REST APIs, authentication issues, database connectivity and service-to-service communication failures.
* Perform SQL queries and investigate data-related application issues.
* Coordinate with DevOps, DBA, monitoring and frontend support teams during critical incidents.
* Support incident triage, service restoration, root cause analysis (RCA) and post-incident reviews.
* Assist with production deployments, hotfix validation and application health checks.
* Escalate complex application defects to the Track A engineering team and coordinate permanent fixes.
* Maintain incident documentation, troubleshooting guides, knowledge-base articles and operational runbooks.
* Participate in rotational shifts and critical-incident escalation support if required.

**Required Technical Skills**

* 4-7 Years of Experience
* Strong hands-on experience in
  **Java 11/17 and Spring Boot**
  .
* Good knowledge of Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate and RESTful APIs.
* Experience troubleshooting microservices and distributed applications.
* Strong SQL knowledge and experience with Oracle or similar relational databases.
* Experience with Linux commands, shell scripting and application log analysis.
* Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, authentication, OAuth2 and JWT.
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines and production deployment processes.
* Experience using monitoring and logging tools such as Grafana, ELK, Splunk or similar.
* Knowledge of incident, problem and change management processes.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Kubernetes and Docker.
* Knowledge of WSO2, Apigee or API gateways.
* Experience supporting telecom applications or high-availability digital platforms.
* Familiarity with Kafka, Redis or messaging technologies.
* Understanding of ITIL practices and SLA-driven support environments.

title: Tech Manager Data Engineering - Retail
description:
**Role Overview**

* As a Senior Engineering Manager – Data Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in leading and scaling enterprise data engineering initiatives for large-scale retail and e-commerce platforms. You will be responsible for managing offshore engineering teams across locations while providing strong technical leadership, architectural direction, and delivery oversight.
* The role requires a combination of deep technical expertise in modern data engineering platforms, particularly Databricks and AWS, strong engineering management capabilities, and a solid understanding of retail and e-commerce data ecosystems.
* You will work closely with customer technology leadership, including Data Engineering Directors, Architects, and Product Owners, to define technical direction, drive data platform modernization, establish engineering standards, and deliver scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient data solutions.
* The ideal candidate is a technically strong engineering leader who can move seamlessly between architecture discussions, engineering problem-solving, delivery governance, and stakeholder management.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of overall IT experience, preferably with 5+ years in data engineering leadership or engineering management roles.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple engineering teams and delivering complex enterprise data engineering programs.
* Strong AWS experience across S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, IAM, and streaming services such as Kinesis or MSK. Proficiency in SQL, Python, PySpark, and dbt.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, including:Lakehouse Architecture and Medallion Architecture. Delta Lake and Delta tables. Unity Catalog and data governance. PySpark and Spark SQL. Databricks Workflows and Jobs. Performance tuning and Spark optimization
* Strong experience in retail, e-commerce, or consumer-facing business domains.
* Understanding of retail data ecosystems, including POS, e-commerce, ERP, CRM, customer loyalty, merchandising, and supply chain.
* Experience building enterprise data platforms supporting high-volume transactions, customer analytics, omnichannel operations, and business intelligence.

title: Sr. DevSecOps Engineer
description:
2Base Technologies is a custom software development company with over 16 years of delivery experience. We work as an enterprise solutions partner for clients in the United Kingdom, the United States, India and other markets, building web and mobile applications and end-to-end digital solutions across industries.

We are adding a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to our DevSecOps team. You will strengthen our security posture, mature our pipelines and automation, and help the team build secure-by-design practice across everything we deliver. Depending on experience, this role can step into the lead position for the team or grow into it.

Key Responsibilities

Define, implement, and enforce security standards, policies, and best practices across cloud and on-prem environments.

Conduct security risk assessments, perform vulnerability scans, coordinate penetration testing activities, and execute mitigation plans.

Architect, maintain, and enhance secure CI/CD pipelines with automated compliance and governance checkpoints.

Promote and uphold a strong “Security First” culture across engineering, ensuring secure design and development practices.

Continuously monitor, detect, investigate, and respond to security threats, incidents, breaches, and anomalies.

Develop, own, and mature automation practices: infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and configuration management using Ansible, alongside other automation frameworks.

Design and maintain secure cloud architectures across AWS, Azure, or GCP to support scalable and compliant deployments.

Build, operate, and secure containerized environments using Docker, with enforced security baselines. Kubernetes where applicable to the project.

Implement and maintain secure monitoring, logging, and alerting systems for infrastructure and application layers, extending to SIEM as the practice develops.

Improve and optimize system reliability, scalability, performance, and fault tolerance across all critical workloads.

Mentor, guide, and upskill DevOps engineers in secure development, automation, and operational excellence.

Lead technical strategy, decision-making, tool selection, process improvements, and DevSecOps roadmap execution.

Work closely with PMO and engineering teams so that security, performance and delivery objectives stay aligned.

Operational Ownership

Backup and disaster recovery: Backup policies, regular tested restoration, and disaster recovery plans with agreed recovery time and data loss targets, with restoration tested rather than assumed.

Release management: Deployments across development, staging and production, including approvals, rollback procedures, and troubleshooting failed releases.

Access and secrets management: Access reviews, joiner and leaver access, service accounts, credentials, secrets rotation, and encryption keys.

Pipeline security: Code, dependency, container image, secrets and Infrastructure-as-Code scanning built into CI/CD, with clear ownership of who fixes what and by when.

Incident management: Leading production incident response, coordinating updates to the people who need them, running root cause reviews, and tracking corrective actions to closure.

Cloud cost management: Monitoring cloud spend, investigating unexpected cost, and improving resource sizing and utilisation without affecting reliability.

Documentation: Infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, deployment guides, operational runbooks and recovery procedures, maintained as the environment changes.

Reliability measurement: Defining and tracking service availability, deployment failure rate, recovery time, and how long vulnerabilities take to close.

Requirements

Required Skills and Experience

6–10 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud, or Infrastructure engineering, including at least 4 years hands-on in DevOps, with strong security exposure.

Strong hands-on expertise in AWS, with a focus on secure architecture.

Deep experience with at least one CI/CD platform, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Bitbucket Pipelines. Breadth across several is useful; depth in one is required.

Experience securing and running Docker containers in production.

Experience independently owning production infrastructure, releases and incident resolution, demonstrated through the work you have led.

Strong understanding of networking technologies: LAN/WAN, firewalls, VPN, load balancers.

Knowledge of security frameworks and standards (OWASP, NIST, CIS Benchmarks).

Working depth in at least one monitoring and logging stack, such as Prometheus and Grafana, the ELK stack, or CloudWatch.

Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, Shell).

Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence engineering teams.

Tools and Technology

These are the areas you will be working in. Core areas are assessed during the interview process. Additional areas strengthen an application, and support is available to develop them in the role.

AWS: Hands-on work across compute, storage, networking, access management and cost, based on environments you have configured.

CI/CD: Building and maintaining pipelines in Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Bitbucket Pipelines, including the security checks within them. Depth in one platform is sufficient.

Git: Version control in practice: branching strategy, merge and release flow, repository access control, and keeping credentials out of version history.

Cloud server administration: Provisioning, sizing, lifecycle and cost of the servers behind the applications, in the cloud and on-premise where it applies.

Ubuntu: Ubuntu Server administration at an operational standard: packages, services, storage, networking, DNS, TLS and permissions.

Monitoring tools: Prometheus and Grafana, the ELK stack, CloudWatch or an equivalent, implemented by you, with judgement about alert severity. Depth in one stack is sufficient.

Server security: Hardening, patching, firewall and SSH configuration, least-privilege access, and closing known vulnerabilities to an agreed timeline.

Terraform: Infrastructure provisioning as code.

Ansible: Configuration management and automation.

Azure: Working depth in the equivalent services, and judgement about what belongs where when a client runs more than one platform.

GCP: Relevant where a client workload sits there.

Kubernetes: Running and securing orchestrated containers in production, where a project uses them.

SIEM and SOAR: Security event collection and response tooling. Prior experience is welcome; where you do not have it, this capability is developed in the role with support.

Education

A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is considered on the same terms.

* Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
* Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
* Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.

* Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
* Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.

* Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
* Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
* Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.
* Backend API Development: Build high-performance backend microservices, middleware, and integration endpoints using Python (FastAPI, Flask, etc.).
* Prompt Engineering & Evaluation: Develop, test, and refine structured system prompts, guardrails, and automated evaluation frameworks to ensure high-accuracy responses and mitigate hallucination.

* Power Platform Experience: Hands-on experience building low-code solutions, custom connectors, or automated workflows using Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate.

* Security & Governance: Familiarity with enterprise data privacy standards, role-based access control (RBAC), and responsible AI practices.

description:
**Position: Lead-DevOps Engineer / DevOps Engineer**

**Total experience: 9+ yrs**

**Employment Type: 1 Year Contract**

**Desired Skills and Experience:**

9+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with substantial hands-on experience in AWS cloud environments.

Strong practical experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining end-to-end CI/CD pipelines and automated release processes.

Hands-on experience in provisioning, configuring, securing, and managing AWS cloud infrastructure.

Practical experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, preferably AWS EKS.

Good understanding of cloud-native application architectures, microservices, distributed systems, and application deployment patterns.

Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code and automation to establish repeatable, consistent, and scalable environments.

Good understanding of cloud networking, application connectivity, load balancing, service discovery, and network security.

Ability to implement and integrate security best practices across the application development and deployment lifecycle.

Understanding of database operations, backup and recovery strategies, data protection, and database changes across application releases.

Ability to identify infrastructure, application deployment, performance, and security risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.

Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident troubleshooting practices.

Understanding of cloud availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and infrastructure cost optimization.

Ability to work effectively with developers, QA engineers, architects, project managers, and security teams to achieve project and operational objectives.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions.

Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate technical issues, document solutions, and participate in technical discussions.

Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to independently manage technical assignments, prioritize activities, and deliver within agreed timelines.

Willingness to learn emerging technologies, share knowledge, mentor team members, and continuously improves existing processes and practices.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

Cloud Platforms (Primary: AWS): Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, including EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, Route 53, ALB/NLB, Auto Scaling, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, Lambda, KMS, and AWS Secrets Manager. Understanding of cloud architecture, high availability, scalability, security, and cost optimization. Exposure to Azure or GCP is an added advantage.

CI/CD & Release Management: Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps; automated build, testing, security scanning, deployment, release management, and rollback strategies.

Containerization & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS EKS/ECS; container deployment, orchestration, scaling, networking, and security.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation: Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible, or equivalent tools for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment automation.

Underlying Cloud Infrastructure: Good understanding of underlying cloud infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, virtualization, operating systems (Linux), resource allocation, high availability, and distributed systems, with the ability to troubleshoot issues across infrastructure and application layers.

Scripting & Programming: Python, Bash etc..for automation, operational tasks, infrastructure management, and troubleshooting.

Security & DevSecOps: AWS IAM, RBAC, authentication (AuthN), authorization (AuthZ), secrets management, encryption, TLS, SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), vulnerability management, and secure deployment practices.

Database & Data Management: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS RDS/Aurora, or equivalent; database backup, snapshotting, replication, recovery, versioning, and schema migration/evolution.

Cloud Networking: AWS VPC/VNet, subnets, routing, security groups, Network ACLs, ALB/NLB, DNS, Route 53, VPN, ingress controllers, service discovery, and network segmentation.

Monitoring & Observability: AWS CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, or equivalent; infrastructure and application monitoring, centralized logging, alerting, and troubleshooting.

Version Control & Collaboration: Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket; branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.

Data Protection & Governance: Understanding of data residency, data sovereignty, encryption at rest and in transit, data classification, access control, retention, and regulatory compliance requirements.

title: IT Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job title: IT Infrastructure Engineer**

**Location: Kochi (Onsite)**

**Contract: Permanent, full-time**

**About us:**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries and 46+ offices. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**

The IT Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for implementing, managing, securing, and supporting IT infrastructure and Cloud Operations across Cyncly’s global environment.

The role combines CloudOps with ongoing operations, with a strong focus on Azure virtual machines, storage, networking, secure connectivity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery. The Engineer will translate approved designs into reliable production environments and provide advanced troubleshooting for cloud and network issues.

Experience with Cisco Meraki, Check Point firewalls, and Microsoft Hyper-V will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Azure Infrastructure Deployment and Operations**

* Deploy, configure, and administer Azure virtual machines, managed disks, availability configurations, and supporting Windows and Linux workloads.
* Manage Azure Storage accounts, including Blob Storage and Azure Files, covering access controls, redundancy, lifecycle management, and data protection.
* Deploy and support infrastructure-related Azure services, including Azure App Service, Key Vault, Azure Backup, and Azure Site Recovery.
* Manage subscriptions, resource groups, resource naming, tagging, and resource lifecycle activities according to organizational standards.
* Configure Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, alerts, and diagnostic settings to support availability, troubleshooting, and operational visibility.
* Support capacity planning, resource sizing, performance tuning, and cost optimization.

**Azure Networking and Secure Connectivity**

* Deploy and manage Azure Virtual Networks, subnets, network interfaces, IP addressing, and Network Security Groups.
* Configure and troubleshoot virtual network peering, route tables, user-defined routes, and traffic flows between Azure, on-premises environments, and remote locations.
* Implement and support Azure VPN Gateway, site-to-site and point-to-site VPNs, and hybrid connectivity.
* Configure and administer Azure Bastion for secure administrative access to virtual machines.
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS zones, Private Endpoints, and connectivity to Azure services.
* Deploy and support Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall, Azure Firewall, and NAT Gateway, as required.
* Troubleshoot routing, DNS resolution, VPN connectivity, latency, packet loss, and firewall-related issues.
* Collaborate with security teams to implement network segmentation, access restrictions, and secure connectivity standards.

**Automation, Security, and Operational Improvement**

* Develop and maintain automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Terraform, Bicep, or similar tools.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code practices to improve deployment consistency and configuration management.
* Implement role-based access control, managed identities, Azure Policy, and secure secret management in line with approved standards.
* Support patching, vulnerability remediation, infrastructure hardening, and backup and recovery validation.
* Use approved AI tools to assist with scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational improvement, while protecting company information and validating outputs.

**Project Delivery, Support, and Documentation**

* Deliver Azure and network infrastructure projects according to approved designs, schedules, budgets, and change management procedures.
* Plan and execute infrastructure migrations, upgrades, and connectivity changes, including testing, rollback planning, and post-change validation.
* Provide L3/L4 troubleshooting for escalated Azure and network incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
* Maintain infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, deployment procedures, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.
* Coordinate operational handovers and knowledge transfer to support teams.
* Participate in on-call support and planned maintenance outside standard working hours, as required.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 6 years of hands-on infrastructure engineering experience, preferably 6–8+ years, with substantial experience in Azure administration and networking.
* Strong practical experience deploying and supporting Azure virtual machines, storage accounts, Blob Storage, managed disks, monitoring, and backup services.
* Hands-on experience with Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, peering, routing, VPN Gateway, Bastion, DNS, and Private Endpoints.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, switching, NAT, VPNs, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.
* Experience administering Windows Server and Linux systems, including their networking and security configurations.
* Proficiency in PowerShell or Azure CLI, with practical experience using an Infrastructure as Code tool.
* Understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, and least-privilege access.
* Experience supporting production environments through incident management, change management, and structured troubleshooting.
* Strong communication, documentation, and coordination skills, with the ability to work across global teams.

**Preferred Skills and Certifications**

* Experience with Network, security policies, NAT, VPN configuration, logging, and troubleshooting.
* **Microsoft Hyper-V (Nice to have):**
  Experience administering virtual machines, virtual switches, failover clusters, and host maintenance.
* Experience with infrastructure migrations and backup and disaster recovery testing.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices and ITSM platforms such as FreshService.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, or Check Point CCSA/CCSE.

**Working for us:**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - come join us.

Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis

* Experience in managing Windows/Linux environments and Database (PostgreSQL ideal)
* Proficiency in scripting languages- Python, JSON, Ruby, C#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud-native/cloud-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)
* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases
* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation
* Hands-on experience with CyberArk Privileged Cloud Suite, including migration from on-prem (self-hosted) environments to Privilege Cloud (PCloud), with strong exposure to SIA, SCA, SWS and WPM capabilities.
* Proven experience in implementing and managing SCIM-based provisioning, Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations, and identity lifecycle management within Privilege Cloud.
* Experience in integrating CyberArk solutions with SIEM platforms using secure tunnel configurations to enable centralized logging, monitoring, and compliance reporting.

* Strong command on verbal and written English language.

* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.

* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur

title: System Administrator
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a skilled and proactive System Administrator to manage, maintain, and support the company's IT infrastructure, systems, servers, and network operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have
**hands-on experience in system administration, network management**
,
**troubleshooting, IT security, and infrastructure maintenance**
to ensure smooth and uninterrupted business operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot physical and virtual servers, desktops, laptops, printers, and other IT hardware and peripherals.
* Administer Windows Server environments and Active Directory, including user account creation, onboarding and offboarding, group policies, and access permissions.
* Monitor and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and VPN connectivity, including routers, switches, and firewall configurations.
* Monitor system health and performance, proactively identify and resolve issues, and minimize infrastructure downtime.
* Deploy, manage, and monitor virtualized environments on VMware and Hyper-V, including virtual machine provisioning, resource allocation, snapshots, and host maintenance.
* Administer Microsoft Azure resources, including virtual machines, storage, networking, identity and access, and cost monitoring, and support connectivity between on-premises and cloud environments.
* Apply operating system updates and security patches on a regular schedule across servers, virtual hosts, and end-user devices.
* Perform and monitor scheduled data backups of physical servers, virtual machines, and cloud workloads, test restores periodically, and support disaster recovery procedures.
* Maintain system security through endpoint protection and antivirus management, access control, and adherence to security best practices.
* Provide technical support to employees for hardware, software, network, and system-related issues, and log and resolve requests within defined timelines.
* Administer email systems, domain and DNS services, and Microsoft 365 / Office 365, including mailboxes, licenses, and security settings.
* Maintain IT asset inventory, software licenses, and up-to-date system and network documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for IT-related purchases, maintenance contracts, and support.
* Ensure compliance with IT policies and prepare periodic reports on IT operations, incidents, and system status.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 1-2 years of relevant experience in System Administration or IT Infrastructure Support.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server administration and Active Directory.
* Good understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN, WAN, and VPN.
* Hands-on experience with firewall, antivirus, and endpoint security management.
* Knowledge of backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 / Office 365 administration.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple IT support requirements.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of Linux server administration.
* Hands-on experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Knowledge of IT security practices and network monitoring tools.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, CompTIA Network+, CCNA, or equivalent would be an advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Technical troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Time management and prioritization.
* Ownership and accountability.
* Effective communication and teamwork.
* Ability to handle IT support requests and resolve issues within defined timelines.

title: Director of Technology Operations
description:
**COMPANY DESCRIPTION:**

Zamorins Solutions is a growing software company founded in 2014 in Des Moines, Iowa, with a strong delivery center in Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala. We began as a web development firm and have expanded into mobile development, business analysis, digital marketing, and our own SaaS products serving clients across North America and beyond. We are looking for a hands-on technology leader to own three core areas: technology operations with strong database and AI capabilities,
day-to-day operations for
our Kochi office, and HR management for our team.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
**:**

* Drive the adoption of AI across our products and internal workflows, turning AI from an idea into working features and measurable time savings.
* Run the Kochi office: daily operations and attendance, so the team stays productive and accountable.
* Own HR management for the Kochi team, from hiring and onboarding to performance, policies, and employee well-being.
* Act as a trusted partner to the CEO, owning execution so leadership can stay focused on growth and strategy.



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN:**

* **Database leadership:**

  design, manage, and optimize relational and cloud databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Supabase or similar); own data modeling, query performance, backups, replication, and disaster recovery.
* **AI and data initiatives:**

  lead the design and delivery of AI features using LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, or similar), including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, AI agents, and workflow automation; evaluate new AI tools and guide responsible use.
* **Technology operations:**

  oversee infrastructure, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Vercel, or similar), deployments, monitoring, uptime, and IT service management (incident, problem, and change processes).
* **Project and delivery management:**

  plan, prioritize, and track technology initiatives using agile methods; manage timelines, sprint goals, deliverables, and quality across product and client projects.
* **Daily operations:**

  manage day-to-day office functioning, work schedules, resource allocation, vendor relationships, and IT assets so work runs smoothly every day.
* **Attendance management:**

  monitor daily attendance, punctuality, leave, and work-from-office compliance; maintain accurate records and share regular attendance reports with leadership.
* **HR management:**

  own the full employee lifecycle: workforce planning, recruitment, interviews, onboarding, and exit processes.
* **HR policies and compliance:**

  create, update, and enforce HR policies, the employee handbook, and leave rules; ensure compliance with Indian labor laws, PF, ESI, and gratuity requirements.
* **Performance and payroll:**

  run goal setting, appraisals, and performance improvement plans; maintain employee records and prepare accurate monthly payroll inputs.
* **Employee relations:**

  handle employee concerns and grievances fairly and promptly; drive engagement, training, and retention initiatives.
* **Security and compliance:**

  enforce data security, access control, and backup policies; support risk management and compliance practices across systems and client data.
* **Team leadership:**

  lead, mentor, and motivate developers and technical staff; build a culture of ownership, learning, and continuous improvement.
* **Reporting and metrics:**

  track performance KPIs for systems, projects, and people; prepare clear weekly reports for the CEO.



**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Proven experience in a senior technology, IT operations, or engineering leadership role, preferably in a software or digital services company.
* Strong, hands-on database expertise: SQL, schema design, performance tuning, and administration of production databases.
* Practical AI experience: has built or shipped AI-powered features or automations using LLM APIs, RAG, vector databases, or machine learning tools.
* Solid knowledge of IT service management, cloud infrastructure, and modern development practices (Git, CI/CD, APIs).
* Strong HR management experience: hiring, onboarding, attendance and leave management, performance appraisals, payroll coordination, and employee relations.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory requirements (PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops and Establishments Act).
* Data Science skills: data analysis, Python or R, data visualization, and applying machine learning to business problems.
* Strong project management and analytical skills; able to read data, diagnose issues, and make sound decisions quickly.
* Familiarity with security, compliance, and risk management practices in IT environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to work clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and international teams. Fluency in Malayalam is preferred.
* PMP, ITIL, cloud, or AI certifications are a plus.
* **A positive, growth-oriented mindset:**

  you thrive in a fast-moving environment, bring solutions rather than excuses, and take ownership as if the business were your own.



**WHY JOIN ZAMORINS**

* Work on real SaaS products and client solutions used across North America.
* Lead AI adoption in a company that is actively investing in it.
* Direct partnership with the CEO and a clear path to grow with the business.
* A collaborative environment focused on continuous learning and innovation.



*This is a full on-site role requiring daily presence at our Kakkanad office. Candidates based in the Kochi area are strongly encouraged to apply.*

**Good to have**

* Knowledge of infrastructure as code and deployment tools such as Terraform, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with data platforms or processing tools such as Spark, Databricks, or cloud-native data services.
* Familiarity with observability tools, application performance monitoring, and structured production-support processes.
* Strong communication, estimation, technical documentation, stakeholder management, and Agile delivery skills.

* Eligibility: Candidates with less than 4 years of relevant professional experience will not be considered.
* Mandatory combination: Actimize, Java, SQL, cloud, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience are all required.

* Clear understanding of the compliance objective, data lineage, operational controls, and regulatory context behind each solution.
* Ownership of design, development, testing, deployment, incident resolution, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

The role provides opportunities to deepen expertise across Actimize, modern Java engineering, cloud delivery, and responsible AI-enabled solutions.

* Ensure compliance with security, performance, and quality standards.

**Required Skills**

* Strong Python programming expertise.
* Experience with:

+ REST APIs and Microservices
+ LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar AI frameworks
+ Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn

From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
About the Job We are seeking an experienced DevSecOps Engineer to secure our applications, AWS infrastructure, and Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) by embedding security into every phase of the development lifecycle. You will collaborate with DevOps, development, and security teams to design, automate, and implement vulnerability management strategies, with a focus on CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and CDN optimization.

● Vulnerability identification & management: Conduct automated scans and assessments of AWS infrastructure, applications, and CDN configurations for vulnerabilities using DevSecOps-integrated tools.

● Evaluate and deploy security tools within CI/CD pipelines for continuous vulnerability detection, tracking, and reporting.

● Prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk impact, leveraging threat intelligence, and drive remediation efforts across cross-functional teams.

● AWS & CDN security: Implement and enforce security best practices across AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, IAM, Lambda, VPC) and CDN platforms (e.g., Cloudflare, Akamai, AWS CloudFront).

● Monitor AWS environments and CDN edge nodes for misconfigurations, threats, and performance-related security risks.

● Leverage AWS Security Hub, Inspector, GuardDuty, and CDN-specific security features (e.g., WAF, DDoS protection) to maintain a robust security posture.

● Application security & DevSecOps: Perform security reviews of application architecture, microservices, APIs, and CDN-integrated delivery systems.

● Embed security into the SDLC by integrating SAST/DAST tools (e.g., Snyk, SonarQube) into CI/CD workflows.

● Collaborate with development teams to shift security left, automating vulnerability detection and remediation in code and deployment pipelines.

● Incident response & remediation: Respond to security incidents across AWS, applications, and CDN infrastructure, coordinating with internal and external teams.

● Conduct root cause analysis for incidents, including CDN-related vulnerabilities, and recommend automated preventative measures.

● Develop and maintain playbooks for vulnerability management and incident response, optimized for DevSecOps workflows.

● Collaboration & automation: Partner with DevOps, Security, and Development teams to integrate security into CI/CD pipelines, IaC (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation), and CDN deployments.

● Drive adoption of DevSecOps practices, including container security (Docker, Kubernetes) and automated threat modeling.

● Provide training and mentorship on secure coding, AWS security, and CDN optimization to stakeholders.

What you’ll need Required qualifications

● Bachelor's Degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

● 8+ years of experience in vulnerability management, AWS security, application security, or DevSecOps roles.

● Strong expertise in AWS services (IAM, S3, EC2, Lambda, VPC) and CDN platforms (e.g., CloudFront, Cloudflare, Akamai).

● Proficiency with vulnerability scanning tools (Wiz, Qualys) and DevSecOps-integrated security tools. ● Hands-on experience with SAST/DAST tools (Snyk, SonarQube) and their integration into CI/CD pipelines.

● Deep understanding of OWASP Top 10, CWE, and CDN-specific security risks (e.g., cache poisoning, DDoS).

● Proven experience with automation, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI), and IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation).

● Familiarity with container security (Docker, Kubernetes) and securing CDN-integrated architectures.

● Knowledge of threat modeling, risk assessments, and penetration testing in a DevSecOps context.

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on automation.

● Excellent communication and collaboration skills to bridge DevOps, Security, and Development teams.

● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote, and DevSecOps-driven environment.

● AWS Certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Security - Specialty, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer).

● Experience with DevSecOps frameworks and tools (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, Checkmarx).

● Hands-on experience securing APIs, microservices, and CDN edge configurations.

● Familiarity with CDN security features like Web Application Firewalls (WAF), rate limiting, and bot management.

● Certification in DevSecOps or related fields (e.g., Certified DevSecOps Professional).

title: Principal Engineer - Confluent
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
**About the job**
We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.
  
  
It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.
  
  
One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are building Kafka Connect charter which is core for scalable and reliable streaming data between Apache Kafka® and other data systems. It makes it simple to quickly define connectors that move large data sets in and out of Kafka. Kafka Connect can ingest entire databases or collect metrics from all your application servers into Kafka topics, making the data available for stream processing with low latency. An export connector can deliver data from Kafka topics into secondary indexes like Elasticsearch, or into batch systems–such as Hadoop for offline analysis.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Engineer to lead the technical vision, architecture, execution, and operations of core engineering teams that build Confluent's industry-leading Kafka Connectors.. As an IC leader of this product line, you will be responsible for guiding the world-class Connect team in driving innovation and outpacing competitors.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Work with a strong team of engineers to help evolve Confluent Connect. Work closely with product management, engineering leadership, and other key stakeholders across various teams in Confluent to build and drive the overall roadmap.
* Drive the long-term direction and strategy of Confluent Kafka connectors, while partnering with internal stakeholders to drive the team’s mission forward
* Drive the technical charter for Connect, and create competitive advantages for Kafka connectors by driving innovation. Drive improvements in the Kafka connectors to make them more usable and powerful for customers, and make them easier to adopt and scale.
* Mentor a team of high-performing engineers and leads, helping them to continue in growing their skill set through hands-on experience and mentorship. Provide timely and productive feedback, encourage a growth mindset, and advise team members in setting and working toward personal development goals.
* Build a culture of continuous improvement and prioritise large and high-impact initiatives that will fundamentally change Kafka connectors.
* Be a strong technical leader and representative for engineering teams in India. Nurture a culture of excellence on the team through a focus on hiring, communication, execution, and work quality. Create and manage processes that enable the team to do its best work.
* Continue a strong growth trajectory by hiring top tier engineers, and establish quality standards, design principles, and operational maturity for the team

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Minimum of 15+ years of hands-on software development experience with the ability to anticipate future technical needs for the product and craft plans to realize them.
* Taking ideas to production is something we look for. Ready to roll up your sleeves - code, debug, design - do whatever it takes to ship the product to production.
* Experience building and operating large-scale systems. Experience running production services in public clouds.
* Strong fundamentals in distributed systems design and development.
* A self starter with the ability to work effectively in teams. Proactively identifying the symptoms of technical issues and reason about their causes is needed. This will be followed by fixing the root causes.
* Timely shipping of deliverables; being able to trade-off short term technical decisions with the long term. Move fast, build in increments, and iterate. A sense of urgency, a mindset towards achieving results, and excellent prioritization skills.
* Ability to influence the team, peers and upper management in technology decisions using effective communication and collaborative techniques
* Strong mentorship track record, guiding the team in building out complex systems, and helping them in their professional development.
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience. Understanding of various technologies, programming paradigms and frameworks is needed. Ability to be pragmatic and trade off their usage in production is essential.

description:

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

* Hands-on experience with CyberArk Privileged Cloud Suite, including migration from on-prem (self-hosted) environments to Privilege Cloud (PCloud), with strong exposure to SIA, SCA, SWS and WPM capabilities.
* Proven experience in implementing and managing SCIM-based provisioning, Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations, and identity lifecycle management within Privilege Cloud.
* Experience in integrating CyberArk solutions with SIEM platforms using secure tunnel configurations to enable centralized logging, monitoring, and compliance reporting.

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

* Establish architecture blueprints, reusable patterns, non-functional requirements and technology guardrails for scalable, secure and responsible AI adoption.
* Evaluate models, frameworks, data stores and cloud AI services based on quality, latency, security, portability, operability and cost.

**Java/J2EE engineering and modernization**

* Architect enterprise solutions using Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security and RESTful APIs.
* Integrate LLM-powered services, copilots and AI agents into existing Java applications and business workflows through well-governed APIs and event-driven patterns.
* Decompose monolithic applications into modular services and define modernization pathways that introduce AI without compromising business continuity.
* Design microservices, event-driven and distributed architectures using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, container platforms and API management.

* Establish CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps and LLMOps practices covering prompt, model and configuration versioning; automated testing; deployment; monitoring; evaluation and rollback.
* Define AI quality and evaluation frameworks for relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability and cost.
* Implement observability across application, model and agent layers, and drive continuous improvement using telemetry and user feedback.
* Lead the transition from proof of concept to hardened, scalable production deployment.

* Embed privacy, data governance, access control, content safety, model security, auditability and Responsible AI requirements into solution design.
* Define controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe outputs, model misuse and third-party model risk.
* Partner with security, risk, legal and compliance stakeholders to align AI solutions with enterprise policies and applicable regulatory obligations.
* Drive cost transparency and FinOps practices for model usage, infrastructure and multi-cloud AI workloads.

**Consulting, leadership and capability building**

* Lead discovery workshops, architecture assessments and design sessions with business and technology stakeholders.

title: L2 Infrastructure & Virtualization Engineer
description:

Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary

As a System Integrator, we are seeking an L2 Infrastructure Engineer responsible for deploying, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise infrastructure at customer sites. This role combines physical hardware deployment with L2 systems support, requiring mandatory expertise in VMware administration, enterprise backup configurations, and physical server/storage hardware management.

Key Responsibilities

●       
Virtualization & Backup (Mandatory): Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot VMware vSphere/vCenter environments, and configure/monitor enterprise backup solutions (e.g., Veeam) to meet client SLAs.

●       
Hardware Deployment: Rack, stack, and mount servers, storage arrays, disk enclosures, and network devices at customer data centers.

●       
Infrastructure Maintenance: Replace failed components (e.g., HDD/SSD, memory, controllers) and coordinate with OEM support to track cases and RMAs.

●       
Remote Management & Cabling: Perform BIOS/firmware updates, configure out-of-band management (iDRAC, iLO, CIMC), and run structured copper and fiber cabling.

●       
Incident Handling & Client Support: Diagnose hardware and virtualization faults, attend customer-site incidents requiring physical intervention, and restore services within agreed SLAs.

Required Qualifications & Skills

●       
Experience: 2–3 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure support and data center environments.

●       
Core Technologies: Mandatory proficiency in VMware/hypervisors and enterprise backup infrastructure.

Hardware Expertise: Solid understanding of server architecture (CPU, memory, RAID) and storage fundamentals (DAS/NAS/SAN, FC/iSCSI/SAS connectivity).

●       
Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

●       
Working Conditions: Comfortable with physical work in racks, occasional extended hours, and traveling to customer sites for installations and emergency support.
